evidence: Every path the brief names exists and is copied into the agent image. instruction.md:13 names /instructions/hireops_rules.md (with 'its section 12') and /instructions/integration.md; instruction.md:15 names /assets/seed_data.json. All three exist under task/environment/, hireops_rules.md:484 is '## 12. Working at the change desk', and environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. The Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template's. task.toml:2 has artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"], as staged-task-contract.md:38 requires. Content agreement: seed_data.json parses; reference_moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z equals hireops_rules.md:58 and app_context.md:27; the constants block equals the prose (band floors 20000000/35000000 vs rules:156-158; signing 12mo/4000bp/500bp/24mo vs rules:314-316; equity 12mo/2000bp/400bp/32mo vs rules:325-327; referral 1000000 cents, 5000bp, 6 months vs rules:337-342; annualization 4 years vs rules:116). The seven seed users (name, email, role, tier) equal the seven accounts in tests/app_context.md:10-16; the password is not in the seed but is given in instruction.md, hireops_rules.md:25 and app_context.md:8, and the golden applies it at db.js:126. Functional P6 (prompt.md:47) names referrer 'Dara', which is seed employee EMP-R1 Dara Whitfield. All offer req_id, referred_by, approved_by/raised_by and all four seed_* offer_id references resolve. The golden's co-located copy solution/app/src/seed_data.json has the same SHA256 as the shipped asset (1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7), and db.js:14 prefers that copy, consistent with instruction.md:17 ('/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime'). Judges do not depend on the optional demonstration rows: instruction.md:17 and rules:91-95 make them optional, app_context.md:21 says they may be absent, functional/prompt.md:27 and :47 tell the judge to create its own controls and not rely on seeded requisition room, and constraints/prompt.md:9 says not to touch seeded offers. Counter-tests tried: an app that skips the demonstration import is not penalised by any criterion text I read; an app that reads /assets at runtime instead of copying fails, but the brief states that requirement explicitly. Not measured by me: an agent-image build (no Docker run in this assignment); the COPY finding is from source and template parity only. One cosmetic point, not a defect for this row: the comment at db.js:126 attributes the credential to instruction.md, which is accurate.
